label: Rigid initial profile denies the single bearer-omission edge checked (inference)
rule: Rigid soundness and preservation at an M-accessible witness; finite decision for the surrogate
meaning: Binds the discriminating premise in its existential form: one E-admitted, M-accessible history lacking the actual initial bearer. The rigid profile denies exactly this edge; restricted inclusion over all such histories is a sufficient strengthening that the qualitative surrogate profile also fails. No warrant for or against the edge is established.
